services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing evening cruise on the Barnegat Bay and Toms River that culminates with a beautiful, summer sunset. BYOB and snacks for the perfect end to your summer day. *Please note that the 6pm time slot is the sunset cruise. If the 6pm time slot is not available on the day you wish to cruise it means it is already booked for that day. Please check the calendar for another
